name: ModelVariant778_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant778_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (smoke puffs rise from random model parts while the ambient light dims; then glows swirl around the opposing slot and rings of spokes expand and fade there until the light recovers); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-795/892 images build the same source unchanged, at the same addresses; only the resident call targets differ. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
